Independently read canonical RUN-376-001, RUN-377-002 and RUN-378-001 all carry head_sha=null while their RESULT.head_sha carries the verified candidate. Genuine existing PRIMARY mapping-review RUN lineage is therefore rejected despite valid source, result and review identities; the fixture supplies a noncanonical populated RUN head_sha.
